title: Bridging FPGA and GPU over PCIe: A Low-Latency Communication Path using AVX-512
problem: Inter-accelerator communication bottlenecks; high latency and complexity in GPU-FPGA bridging
motivation: Need low-latency FPGA-GPU communication for hybrid accelerator systems; DMA overhead limits performance
method: Programmed I/O using AVX-512 instructions for PCIe communication; GPU peer-to-peer memory mapping
key_novelty: Sub-2 microsecond latency via direct PCIe I/O; GPU P2P remapping without DMA; simpler software stack
contributions: Programmed I/O mechanism for FPGA-GPU communication
